text: It sounds like you're really enjoying practicing your keyboard piece, even if it's just for a short time each day. Given your time constraint, you might consider using this session to focus on the section where you tend to lose your place. Try to work through it at a pace that allows you to follow the notes, and then see if you can connect it to the section that comes before it. Keep in mind that you don't need to cover the entire piece in this session, and it's also important to remember that improvement isn't guaranteed within just ten minutes.
